//: Typecheck gate for the parts of the tree tsc can read on its own: the data
layer, the library and the API routes. Astro components are excluded because
they are not TypeScript files; `astro check` is the tool for those.
`astro/client` is in `types` and has to be. Without it `import.meta.env` is
undeclared, and src/lib/auth.ts and src/pages/api/auth/login.ts report three
TS2339 errors for code that is correct and ships every day. A gate that
reports failures nobody can act on is a gate people learn to skip, which is
worse than not having one -- it was masking two real TS7022s and three
src/env.d.ts carries the same reference for the editor, but `include` below
deliberately does not cover it, so it has to be named here as well.
